units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:6">Kel. XIII, 6</cite> <he>עץ המשמש את המ׳</he> the wooden part of a utensil which is subservient to the metallic part.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:7">Ib. 7</cite> <he>עשאו של מ׳</he> he replaced it by a metallic tooth; a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="M03070"><he>מַתָּכוֹת</he></cite>.—<he>כְּלֵי מ׳</he> metallic vessels, utensils, tools &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 1:6">Ḥull. I, 6</cite>; a. v. fr.
